title: "Reproducibility"
subtitle: "Environment, data lineage and complete execution"
---



## Software requirements

A complete reproduction requires:

- R;
- Quarto;
- Git.

R package versions are recorded through `renv`.

## Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/USERNAME/bank-liquidity-funding-fragility-bolivia.git

cd bank-liquidity-funding-fragility-bolivia
```

## Restore the R environment

```bash
Rscript -e "install.packages('renv', repos='https://cloud.r-project.org')"

Rscript -e "renv::restore()"
```

## Reproduce the complete empirical analysis

```bash
Rscript run_all.R
```

The pipeline is:

```text
data/raw/Datos RL SB.xlsm

          ↓

R/01_build_icvlf.R

          ↓

output/bloque1/diagnosticos/
OBJETOS_ICVLF_v6_3_BLOQUE1.rds

          ↓

R/02_generate_outputs.R

          ↓

output/bloque2/

          ↓

R/03_export_public_data.R

          ↓

data/processed/
```

## Render the research website

```bash
quarto render
```

The rendered website is written to:

```text
docs/
```

The analysis stores an MD5 checksum of the source workbook.

This provides a simple audit of whether a reproduced analysis used the
same source file.

## Reproducibility contract

A clean replication is successful only when:

1. the documented raw workbook is available;
2. the temporal audit passes;
3. numerical parsing passes;
4. coverage requirements pass;
5. five dimensions are constructed;
6. dimensional weights satisfy their identities;
7. the baseline ICVLF identity passes;
8. the master RDS is generated;
9. publication outputs are generated;
10. processed public datasets are generated;
11. Quarto renders without error.

## Analytical outputs

The master RDS contains the data and diagnostics required to recreate
the published website without recalculating alternative versions of the
model.

## Automation

The public repository uses GitHub Actions to:

1. restore the R environment;
2. reproduce the empirical analysis;
3. render Quarto;
4. publish GitHub Pages.
